name: Moving Atoms
long_description:
Moving Atoms is frontier robotics lab. Our goal is to solve robotics, then solve abundance.

Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics, already tops the Physics IQ benchmark.

By using this model, we can significantly reduce the amount of robot data we need to collect to build our robot model (a world action model).

Our second core bet is to design our robot model to be micromanaged by LLMs, allow robotics to use the orchestration and planning abilities of LLMs while having the physics, contact and timing be controlled by the robot model (world action model).
